description: Per-track rulings on the super turbo pad finish rule (#133 PR 4c). A custom track whose LEV has super turbo pads needs USF to finish unless a ruling here says otherwise (ruling 2026-10-18: "they require USF UNLESS I say otherwise"). Keyed by registry content id (the package's content_id); usf_finish true needs USF to finish, false takes the generic terms only. Each entry cites its ruling. Project-owned: this is never a package descriptor field. A track not listed keeps the measured default.
